about: S7 卷尾 · 趙太丞家 (city_end): who speaks and what (the life pass, gen/life/progress.md; format tools/talk_data.mjs; brief gen/life/brief_section.md). The scroll's end, 余辉's 結尾三問: 問病 at the doctor's shop, 問道 at the official's gate (問命 at the 解 sign is S6's). scenes: near talks (press E at the host; `as` = the line for who you play, `again` = the next talk with the same host). chatter: groups that talk among themselves when you are within earshot. barks: a lone figure's word now and then (`close`: a call to you as you come near). Every role is a painted figure of people.json; every line cites its reading (src); 繁體, no numbers on screen; lines fit the figure's clips. Plot-line step wine.5 (the sign 治酒所傷真方集香丸) is carried by V7.1 and the exchanges marked with it. Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs into web/public/assets/ui/talk.json.

scenes.title: 太丞問病
scenes.reading: 名画记 48: a medicine shop right by the well, its tablets read 赵太丞家; a counter inside with a written paper (perhaps a prescription) and what looks like an abacus; of the tall boards outside only one reads in full, 治酒所伤真方集香丸; the 正店 and 脚店 ahead are full, so drinking was the fashion and many were hurt by it. 余辉 2021 问病: two women bring a child; he guesses their husbands drank till drunk the day before; 赵太丞 served the court as a physician, where high and low drank themselves ill; the boards also offer cures for 五劳七伤. The map: the man in a dark robe stands facing the women and reaches with both hands to the child on the seated woman's lap, his armchair empty behind him. Scholars differ: 余辉 2021 sees an old woman of the shop comforting the women while they wait for the old doctor; we follow the map (the dark-robed man is the doctor, already examining the child). Which board carries the 集香丸 text the strokes don't show, so the lines say only 'the sign outside'.

scenes.title: 門前問路
scenes.reading: 名画记 49: next to 赵太丞家 a deep compound; the brackets under the gate's eave and the mounting block mark an official household; a stranger with a food box in his hand and a big bundle on his shoulder, come perhaps to visit kin in 汴京, is shown the way, and looking where the finger points, the street trees close in a haze and the scroll stops there. 余辉 2021 问道: a country man come to visit family has lost his way and asks at the official's gate; the painter, too, asks which way the country should go. 東京夢華錄 卷五 民俗: the townsfolk show newcomers the way and stand up for strangers. Who points: 名画记 and 余辉 call him the gatekeeper; the map paints a seated gatekeeper and a man in a dark cap who points west. Chosen: the man in the dark cap points (a doorman of the house, 門子); the seated man is the gatekeeper (門公). The small head at the door leaf may be a lamp (the map: one thing); people.json places a child, so a child it is.

scenes.title: 門房閒話
scenes.reading: 名画记 49: the brackets under the gate's eave and the mounting block mark an official household, next door to 赵太丞家. The map: the bearded gatekeeper sits on a low box seat by the fence, head tilted back, mouth open, hands raised, talking up to a man leaning at the gate's west post (a servant or second doorman). That the household's master is the broad-hatted official riding east down the street is our proposal (the map puts the retinue a few steps east; Hansen plate 26 pairs the Zhao pharmacy and the rider).

scenes.title: 官人出行
scenes.reading: The map: a bearded official in a very broad hat and a pale round-collared robe rides east, a thin stick (a riding whip?) behind his shoulder; a groom at the horse's head looks up at him, an attendant in pale with a pole walks in front, and behind the horse an attendant with mouth open carries a long folded object over his shoulder (a parasol or a long-handled fan: we read a parasol). Hansen plate 26 pairs him with the Zhao pharmacy. 余辉 2021: the scroll's few horses are officials' mounts or haul wine, not one a warhorse. Where he rides (the wine house) is our proposal.
